_help: Art for games that have none of their own. 'aliases': the same game under another name in another list. Key: '<collection>/<item>' as the game lists name it; value: the '<collection>/<item>' whose medium_artwork it uses. 'files': single files, '<collection>/<item>': { '<art type>': '<file>' }, e.g. a PC game's own intro movie as its video (skipped on a cabinet that doesn't have the file). New-RetroFECollections.ps1 hard-links each art type the game has none of (video, fanart, logo, artwork, controls cards ...), never replaces its own art, and lists each link in medium_artwork\ARCADEMASTER-borrowed-art.txt so it can be removed. Stories are not linked: write those in tools\game-stories.json. 'clips': a game's own movie (attract / intro / trailer) made into a 45 s 720p menu video by tools\New-GameClips.ps1 (into D:\ArcadeMaster\media\clips\<collection>\<item>.mp4) and used as its video; 'start' skips logos (seconds).
